### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `msm8998-mtp.dtsi` enable Coresight components specifically for the MSM8998 MTP device, allowing it to utilize these features without issues.
- Conversely, the changes in `msm8998.dtsi` disable the same Coresight components for the general MSM8998 device, preventing boot failures due to the lack of firmware support. 
- This patch effectively differentiates the configuration of Coresight components between the MTP and standard MSM8998 devices, ensuring that only the MTP device has these features enabled while the standard device has them disabled to avoid operational issues.
